why: A skipped check is not a passed check.  Actions run #3 (2026-08-20) was the
first time this suite ran on a machine that is not Panya's bridge, and four
tests went red because they reached for evidence that a clone cannot have.
The fix is a skip with a declared reason - but an unpinned skip is how a real
test drifts into the skip pile without anybody noticing, so every skip this
suite is allowed to produce is written down here, by module, with a count.
tools/pf_pytest_precondition_census.py compares this file against what pytest
actually reported and goes red when they disagree IN EITHER DIRECTION.
HOW AN ENTRY IS EVALUATED (computed on the spot, never quoted):
expected = 0        if the module was excluded from this pytest selection
expected = 0        if the precondition's artifact IS present on this machine
expected = 'count'  otherwise
So the same pin file is correct on the bridge (all artifacts present, nothing
excluded: 1 skip total) and on a fresh clone in CI (artifacts absent, the
client/corpus modules excluded: 4 skips).  Neither number is hand-typed for a
machine; both fall out of the same rule.
TO CHANGE A NUMBER HERE you must change it in the same commit as the test that
moved it, exactly as COVERAGE_EVIDENCE_DEBT_PIN says about itself.  Round 105
spent a whole round on two pins that were measured before a fix and published
after it; do not add a third.

preconditions.note: Both run the replay tool with no --db, so the tool falls back to the canonical database and exits 2 without it.  test_the_replay_tool_refuses_a_missing_database_in_pure_ascii covers the cp874 and exit-code contract on every machine and must never be added to this list.
Reads two v94 capture files under backups/.  test_the_v94_provenance_paths_are_declared_machine_local keeps a real assertion on the same golden data everywhere.

test_the_login_capture_guard_states_which_machine_it_is_on asserts on BOTH machines - 'reproduced' where the capture exists, exactly 'skipped (untracked capture absent)' where it does not - so nothing goes silent here.

design_skips.reason: runtime.py now carries the dispatcher branch
design_skips.note: Not a missing artifact: the test guarded a transitional state that the source has since left behind.  It is pinned so it cannot quietly become two.
